description_en: This API is used to obtain the distribution data of operating systems and SDK versions in quality statistics

name: DescribeQualityOsSdkVersionDistributionStatData

parameters.help_en: Start Time of the query, represented as a UNIX timestamp, in seconds.

parameters.name: end_date
